note: Add a card by saving the unlabeled square (avatar, handle, full post, no MemeStand header) as images/post-cards/<slug>.jpg and adding an entry here. Do not put these files in images/<id>.jpg: that folder is the 400px photo-thumbnail store and rank.py will shrink it. image_policy none still blocks unlisted third-party photos. A listed card is shown only when the meme has no photo of its own.
